newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB 1-week repo tender yields 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB 1-week repo tender yields 45 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Czech National Bank (CNB) one-week repo tender on Monday was 44.45 percent, the CNB said.
Maximum accepted yield was 45 percent, and all bids at this level were accepted, the CNB said. No details on the total volume of the transactions were released.
No limit yield was set on the one-week tender.
The central bank said that it also accepted all bids in a separate overnight repo tender at 30 percent, while the average yield in was 29.63 percent. No limit yield was set in that tender either.
Earlier on Monday, CNB accepted all bids at 45 percent in two overnight tenders, where the limit yield was set at 45 percent.

On Friday, the central bank raised its last-resort Lombard rate to 50 percent from 14 percent in an attempt to support the crown which had fallen to record lows of minus five percent against its mark/dollar basket on weak economic signals.
The CNB raised its repo rate on Friday to 12.9 percent from 12.4 percent and said it would set the rate flexibly according to market conditions.
